ai_summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited reported robust operational growth for the half year ended September 30, 2026, with interest income up over 30% and net profit increasing by approximately 19.5% year-over-year, driven by a significant expansion in its loan book. This growth was largely funded by a substantial 72.5% increase in debt securities over six months, leading to a material 51.5% rise in finance costs which outpaced total income growth. While the limited review report carries no adverse remarks, the disproportionate increase in finance costs relative to income growth warrants careful monitoring of funding efficiency and profitability margins.
